body: Q: Does fearlessness mean noi being afraid of fear? A: Yes, to be fearless means not being intimidated by fear. Not being intimidated by fear means whether you experience fear or not it can no longer have the power to prevent you from doing the right thing. When fear can no longer prevent you from doing the right thing it is living proof that you have won. Fear must not be able to frighten you to such adegree that it inhibits correct action. It is when we act that karma is created, and that is why action itself must be correct. The more you are able to do the right thing, the correct action, the more free you will know yourself to be. Q; Are you saying that there are good and bad actions? A: No, not good and bad actions. I'm speaking about right actions, or correct actions. That is the Enlightened action which is not motivated by fear or desire; that action which is not motivated by self-interest. Enlightenment is the end. Realize that. Find it for yourself. That is as far as you have to go. If you realize that and stay there right action will be the result. 2 2 3 r - Destruction oi Karma Does Thought Create Karma?
